gold.rule: Every substrate matches the chip, never the hex and never another substrate.
gold.measurement: Spectrophotometer, D65 illuminant, 10 degree observer, measured on the production substrate.

substrates.digital_print: Closest available build; known compromise, not for packaging
substrates.anodised_aluminium: Match Pantone 1235 C within dE2000 2.0 against an approved master panel
substrates.powder_coat: Match Pantone 1235 C within dE2000 2.0; do not substitute a RAL number
substrates.textile: Choose and record the nearest Pantone TCX using a physical fan
substrates.plastic: Pantone PQ match on a production-thickness part

master.status: chosen from published values; physical fan confirmation pending

green.anodised_aluminium: Match Pantone 7743 C within dE2000 3.0 against an approved master panel
